superseded_measurements.why_superseded: re-measured because the executor ran CPU-side commands (pytest, imports) concurrently with these runs; original values kept here
re-measured because the executor ran CPU-side commands (pytest, imports) concurrently with these runs; original values kept here

deviations: Encode-load liveness check: the first load pass verified the encode by requiring NVML encoder utilisation > 0 in 5 samples over 1 s; a real-time 1080p30 encode keeps NVENC only ~7-14% busy and the counter often reads 0, so 4 configuration x camera entries were wrongly recorded as not_attempted. The check now uses NVML encoder session statistics (an active session) and those 4 entries were re-measured; the other load entries ran with the encode alive and are unchanged.
notes.reproducibility: Re-run from a clean setup on 2026-10-19 (deleted bench/.venv, bench/vendor and outputs/; ran setup.ps1, which re-cloned CorridorKey at the pinned SHA, re-downloaded the weights (same sha256) and re-created the environment in 44 s from uv's cache; rebuilt the TensorRT engine for the deciding configuration only; re-ran `speed` for it idle and under the NVENC load at 1080p, run `20261019T091842Z-40cab3`). The table format is identical and every median agrees within 10% (PASS): trt-fp16-1024x576-ref0-idle model median 22.6 -> 23.0 ms (+1.7%); trt-fp16-1024x576-ref0-idle e2e median 28.6 -> 29.1 ms (+1.8%); trt-fp16-1024x576-ref0-idle e2e p95 (worst run) 29.4 -> 30.5 ms; trt-fp16-1024x576-ref0-nvenc1080p30 model median 23.1 -> 23.5 ms (+1.5%); trt-fp16-1024x576-ref0-nvenc1080p30 e2e median 29.3 -> 29.9 ms (+2.0%); trt-fp16-1024x576-ref0-nvenc1080p30 e2e p95 (worst run) 30.1 -> 31.5 ms.
notes.schedule: Implementation started 2026-10-16 and the report was completed on 2026-10-19, within the 5-working-day limit.

a2000_estimate.reason: a lighter mode at the same or lower fps already failed

verdict.reasoning: The 1080p30 gate (<= 20 ms p95 at internal >= 768 on both sides, under encode load, quality accepted) is not met. The target mode, 1080p30, is sustained with trt-fp16-1024x576-ref0-nvenc1080p30 at 30.1 ms p95 (budget 33.3 ms) but without the gate's headroom. Supported modes on the RTX 3060: 720p20, 720p30, 1080p30, 1080p60, 2160p30.
verdict.a2000_risk: A2000 ESTIMATE for 1080p30: 24.3-30.9 ms vs 33.3 ms budget: supported. Must be confirmed on the A2000.
verdict.prior_evidence_note: Before this spike, no frame rates had been published by CorridorKey's authors. Third-party ports reported, unverified: an After Effects port on an RTX 4090 (fp16, 1080p source, including I/O and post-processing) at about 187 ms/frame at 512 without the refiner, 230 ms with it, 286 ms at 1024 and 612 ms at 2048; and a Nuke TensorRT port on an RTX A5000 (fp16, 2048) at about 300 ms/frame. Those figures made the 1080p30 gate unlikely before any measurement here; they include unknown host overhead and none were taken on this hardware.
